review.reviewer: Codex AI engineering/source-agreement inspection; not independent legal review

first_pass_findings.finding: Clear private-employment contexts or general rule requests misclassified or unnecessarily clarified.
Unrelated was incorrectly treated as permission to discard a separate current concern.
Boundary, comma enumeration, actor propagation or exclusion-recognition errors.
Ordinary English words badly, pot and printer were incorrectly rewritten by local phonetic/boundary features.
Anaphoric requests or coordinate subjects created duplicate, irrelevant or false unanswered components.
Retrieval intent mismatch for noisy deductions, closure and refurbished-as-new sales.
Source agreement or issue coverage needs more than exact citations and same-model acceptance: narrowed status answer, actor/return conditions, overbroad findings, and missing defense qualification.

second_pass_followup_findings.finding: Source requires payroll records; explanation additionally said the same entries must appear on an individual payslip.
Anti-circumvention condition attached to advance notice rather than permission to close.
Remaining same-scenario grouping or requested-focus mismatch; some topics genuinely lack indexed authority.
Third-party defense omitted; initial deterministic check depended on an exact source phrase and missed the recorded wording variant.
Broad paid-service focus excluded the specific replacement-parts authority; exposed by the 436-input regression, not counted among fresh 100.

source_gaps_retained: Night-pay authority is not present in the selected index

final_closure_followup.finding: The 17-case check omitted the serious-business-losses condition when mentioning closure separation pay.
final_closure_followup.repair: Added a fail-closed source-qualification guard and an explicit drafting focus.
final_closure_followup.verification: closure-check returned a qualified explanation preserving serious business losses/financial reverses and the advance notice; original observations remain saved.
